purpose: Test read-time result loss while the local object store and durable job record remain available
intervention: Delete only the result object of a newly submitted synthetic text-topic-v1 job, then restore its exact bytes in a finally block
limits: This is one deliberately injected local object loss, not a spontaneous storage incident.
The object store remains healthy; deleting one result differs from the earlier MinIO outage during input checking.
The workbench has no rule for read-time result loss; abstention is expected even though the external intervention ledger identifies the injected cause.
No user video or existing job artifact is modified.
